typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Calling_customer as string,
		Assigned_Individual as string,
		Ticket_Number as string,
		Ticket_Type as string,
		Team as string,
		State as string,
		Severity as string,
		Created as date,
		Resolved_At as date,
		Total_Worked_Time as string,
		Title as string,
		{Resolution Remarks} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		Ticket_Type as string,
		Calling_customer as string,
		Ticket_Number as string,
		Total_Worked_Time as string,
		Title as string,
		Severity as string,
		Assigned_Individual as string,
		Resolved_At as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FName as string,
		Created as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EtlUser as string,
		State as string,
		Team as string,
		ResolutionRemarks as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		Ticket_Type,
		Calling_customer,
		Ticket_Number,
		Total_Worked_Time,
		Title,
		Severity,
		Assigned_Individual,
		Resolved_At,
		FName,
		Created,
		EtlUser,
		State,
		Team,
		ResolutionRemarks = {Resolution Remarks}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
